record.question: The client is newly diagnosed with juvenile onset diabetes. Which of the following nursing diagnoses is a priority?
record.explanation: Answer D: Knowledge deficit. For a newly diagnosed child with type 1 diabetes, knowledge deficit about lifelong insulin, glucose monitoring, hypoglycemia, and sick-day care is an appropriate priority nursing diagnosis among these choices. Source/context note: Immediate assessment must first address physiologic instability or acute complications; those are not options here. Reference: https://www.niddk.nih.gov/health-information/diabetes/overview/what-is-diabetes/type-1-diabetes. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
